in_sanskrit.name: पुष्पिता
in_sanskrit.meaning: golden, adorned with flowers, having the quality of flowers
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Pushpita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pushp' meaning 'flower' and the suffix '-ita' which means 'having the quality of'. So, Pushpita means 'having the quality of flowers' or 'adorned with flowers'.

in_hindi.name: पुष्पिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi translation of Pushpita is 'Pushpika', which also means 'having the quality of flowers' or 'adorned with flowers'.

in_tamil.name: புச்சிப்பிடா
in_tamil.meaning: புச்சி meaning 'flower' + ழிடா meaning 'having the quality of'
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of Pushpita is 'Puccipida'. The first part of the name, 'Pucci', means 'flower' and the second part, 'Pida', means 'having the quality of'. So, Puccipida means 'having the quality of flowers' or 'adorned with flowers'.

in_telugu.name: పుశ్పిదా
in_telugu.meaning: పుశ్పి meaning 'flower' + దా meaning 'having the quality of'
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of Pushpita is 'Puspida'. The first part of the name, 'Puspi', means 'flower' and the second part, 'Ida', means 'having the quality of'. So, Puspida means 'having the quality of flowers' or 'adorned with flowers'.
